subject: POC: Prompt & Log Deliverables + Success Criteria (Sunrise Analytics)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@sunrise-analytics.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@sunrise-analytics.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: POC: Prompt & Log Deliverables + Next steps (recap)

Hi Olivia / Raj — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and agreed next steps so we have a single source of truth.

Scope agreed:
- 2-week POC focused on the customer-facing assistant flows (FAQ + account support).
- Redwood will provision a small dedicated pool for the trial and provide dashboards + an evaluation harness.

Deliverables requested from Sunrise (target by Tue 6/22):
1) Prompt set: ~500 representative user prompts covering the 4 priority intents (billing, account lookup, troubleshooting, product info). Format: JSONL (one object per line) using the attached prompt_template.jsonl. Fields we need: id, user_prompt, system_prompt (optional), expected_behavior, intent_bucket.
2) Server logs: ~1,000 anonymized interaction logs (JSON) showing full user request, system prompt, assistant output, and basic metadata (timestamp, device-type). PII must be redacted/hashes only — see redwood-poc-checklist.pdf (attached) for examples.
3) Sample acceptance comments / business rules: 10-15 exemplar queries with a short note on what constitutes an acceptable response.

Success criteria (high level):
- Functional: accuracy of answers per your rubric (we'll refine below).
- Performance: p95 token latency target <= 250ms under trial load.
- Safety & fidelity: hallucination rate under 5% as measured on the verification set.

Log transfer options: pre-signed S3 link, SCP to our sftp.redwood.internal (we can provide creds via secure share), or upload to a shared Drive folder (least preferred). Let us know which you prefer.

Action items / owners:
- Sunrise: collect prompts + logs (Olivia / Raj)
- Redwood: provide template, validation script, and short ingest guide (Vanessa / Sean)
- Redwood Eval: Marissa will own metric definitions and dashboarding.

Attachments: prompt_template.jsonl, redwood-poc-checklist.pdf

If the delivery timeline is tight for you, tell us and we can stagger — e.g., send an initial 200 prompts + 200 logs to unblock early evaluation.

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@sunrise-analytics.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@sunrise-analytics.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC: Prompt & Log Deliverables + Next steps (recap)

Thanks Vanessa — very clear, and appreciate the template. A few quick questions from our side before we compile everything: 

1) Success criteria — can you provide more detail on the evaluation rubric you plan to use? Are you planning human labels or automated similarity scoring?
2) Data handling — our legal team needs clarification on retention windows and whether any examples will be used to improve Redwood models outside our tenancy.
3) Timeline — legal needs one extra week for sign-off on log sharing (so +7 days). Would it be okay to shift the full delivery to 6/29 instead of 6/22? We can send an initial 150 prompts + 150 logs by 6/22 to avoid blocking the setup.

Attached is a small sample (sunrise_sample_prompts.csv) we used internally — contains 60 prompts across billing & product info. Note: the file still contains hashed user IDs that our security team insisted on keeping.

Also, Raj asked whether Redwood needs device-level metadata for the logs or just a high-level "channel" (web/mobile).

Thanks — Olivia
Olivia Chen
Head of Product | Sunrise Analytics

Subject: Re: POC: Prompt & Log Deliverables + Next steps (recap)

Hi Olivia / Raj — thanks for the quick reply and for the sample. Happy to accommodate the extra week for legal. Updated plan below.

Timeline update:
- Initial tranche (150 prompts + 150 logs): targeted delivery 2027-06-22 (to unblock environment setup).
- Full dataset (500 prompts + 1,000 logs): targeted delivery 2027-06-29.

Evaluation approach (what Redwood will run):
- Step 1: Automated checks (schema validation, PII detection, prompt coverage).
- Step 2: Synthetic augmentation & canonicalization (we normalize prompt variants into buckets).
- Step 3: Metric suite run against the verification set (we'll ask you for ~200 ground-truth checks).

Proposed success criteria (concrete):
- Latency: p95 response-time <= 250ms at trial TP50 load (measured by Redwood's tracing).
- Quality: semantic-accuracy >= 85% on our rubric (rubric combines binary correctness + partial-credit for multi-step answers).
- Hallucination: <5% of sampled outputs flagged as hallucinations by human verification.
- Cost: average inference cost per 1k tokens within your targeted budget (we'll align on a target number once you share budget range).
- Security: data retained only for the trial period (default 30 days) unless you request longer; nothing will be used to fine-tune public models — all processing will be in your tenancy for the Private/Dedicated option or under contractual restrictions for Hosted.

Ingest details: device/channel — web/mobile/channel string is sufficient. Do not include raw PII (we will run checks). If you want, our security contact (CC'ed) can sign the data handling statement.

Owners & immediate asks:
- Sunrise (Olivia): confirm you can deliver initial tranche 6/22 and full set 6/29. Please provide preferred transfer method (S3 presigned link preferred).
- Redwood (Sean): prep ingestion pipeline; Sean, I'll need a short validation script for Olivia to run locally and confirm schema.
- Redwood (Marissa): draft the exact rubric + sample verification tasks (Marissa will send by EOD tomorrow).

If you prefer, we can also do a short 30-min follow-up to walk through the rubric and data template. Otherwise we will proceed as above.

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
